observations: Actual UE scene is visible in all four distinct renders; no UI, grid, selection or Hello overlay.
Overview shows the complete 100m square, station, freight yard, curved track and tunnel.
Top-down shows site extents and the connected arrival/ramp/platform routes.
Platform view shows edge coping, rail clearance, canopy, benches, windows and luggage.
Track view shows continuous rails and sleepers entering the open arch and continuing through the short tunnel.
limitations: Stylized freestanding rock-covered short tunnel; open far exit and faceted interior shoulders remain visible.
Station is exterior-only. The small station occupies a restrained portion of the 100m terrain.
No performance benchmark or exhaustive human walk-through was performed.
